description.en: Doubled the wavelength instead of halving it — confusing which quantity doubles (frequency) with which one halves (wavelength).
description.et: Kahekordistas lainepikkuse selle poolitamise asemel — segi läks, kumb suurus kahekordistub (sagedus) ja kumb poolitub (lainepikkus).

description.en: Reported the input wavelength unchanged, as if second-harmonic generation didn't shift the wavelength at all.
description.et: Andis vastuseks muutumatu sisendlainepikkuse, nagu ei muudaks II harmoonilise genereerimine lainepikkust üldse.

description.en: Divided by three instead of two, as if computing a third harmonic instead of the second.
description.et: Jagas kolmega, mitte kahega, nagu arvutaks III harmoonilist, mitte II harmoonilist.
